questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic feature of prokaryotic cells?
questions.solution: Prokaryotic cells lack membrane-bound organelles, which is a key characteristic that distinguishes them from eukaryotic cells. The other options describe features of eukaryotic cells, not prokaryotic ones.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a non-membrane bound organelle found in all cells?
questions.solution: Ribosomes are non-membrane bound organelles found in all cells, both eukaryotic and prokaryotic. The other options are membrane-bound organelles, which are not present in prokaryotic cells.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about ribosomes?
choices: They are surrounded by a membrane
They are composed of DNA and proteins
They are found only in eukaryotic cells
They are smaller in prokaryotes than in eukaryotes
questions.solution: The correct answer is that ribosomes are smaller in prokaryotes than in eukaryotes. Prokaryotic ribosomes are 70S, while eukaryotic ribosomes are 80S. The other options are incorrect because ribosomes are not surrounded by a membrane, they are composed of RNA and proteins, and they are found in both prokaryotes and eukaryotes.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a function of the stroma in a chloroplast?
choices: It contains enzymes for the synthesis of carbohydrates and proteins
It stores proteins in the form of aleuroplasts
It contains ribosomes that are 80S in size
It is responsible for the movement of the cell
questions.solution: The stroma of the chloroplast contains enzymes required for the synthesis of carbohydrates and proteins. The other options are incorrect because aleuroplasts store proteins, ribosomes in chloroplasts are 70S, and movement is associated with cilia or flagella, not the stroma.

questions.stem: What is the main difference between Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria?

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct feature of prokaryotic ribosomes?
choices: They are 70S in size and made of 50S and 30S subunits
They are membrane-bound and found in the nucleus
They are responsible for lipid synthesis
They are larger than eukaryotic ribosomes
questions.solution: Prokaryotic ribosomes are 70S in size and consist of 50S and 30S subunits, which combine to form the 70S ribosome. This is a key characteristic of prokaryotes. The other options are incorrect because ribosomes in prokaryotes are not membrane-bound or found in the nucleus, they are not responsible for lipid synthesis, and they are not larger than eukaryotic ribosomes.

questions.stem: Based on the diagram, which of the following is a function of the plasma membrane in prokaryotic cells?
choices: To control the movement of substances
questions.solution: The plasma membrane controls the movement of substances in and out of the cell, acting as a selective barrier. The other options describe functions of other structures like the cell wall and mitochondria.

hi.stem: आर्कियोटिक कोशिकाओं में प्लाज्मा झिल्ली के कार्य के बारे में आरेख के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक कार्य है?

mr.solution: प्लाझ्मा झिल्ली कोशिकेच्या आत आणि बाहेर द्रव्यांच्या गतीचे नियंत्रण करते, जे निवडक अवरोध असते. इतर विकल्पांमध्ये कोशिका भिंत आणि माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया यांच्या कार्याचे वर्णन केले जाते.

questions.stem: What is the primary function of the Golgi apparatus?
questions.solution: The Golgi apparatus is responsible for modifying and packaging proteins for transport to their final destinations within or outside the cell. This process involves adding carbohydrates and other molecules to proteins. The other options describe functions of different organelles, such as lipid synthesis by the smooth endoplasmic reticulum and ATP production by mitochondria.

hi.stem: गॉल्गी एपैरेटस का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
hi.solution: गॉल्गी एपैरेटस कोशिका के भीतर या बाहर अपने अंतिम गंतव्य तक प्रोटीन के परिवहन के लिए उनके संशोधन एवं पैकेजिंग के लिए उत्तरदायी होता है। इस प्रक्रिया में प्रोटीन पर कार्बोहाइड्रेट एवं अन्य अणुओं को जोड़ा जाता है। अन्य विकल्प अन्य कोशिकांगों के कार्यों का वर्णन करते हैं, जैसे स्मूथ एंडोप्लाज्मिक रेटिकुलम द्वारा लिपिड का संश्लेषण एवं माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया द्वारा एटीपी का उत्पादन।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate biological terminology.

mr.stem: गॉल्गी अॅपरेटसचे प्राथमिक कार्य काय आहे?
mr.solution: गॉल्गी अॅपरेटस हे प्रोटीनचे संशोधन आणि पॅकिंग करण्यासाठी जबाबदार आहे, जेणेकरून ते त्यांच्या अंतिम ठिकाणी बाहेर किंवा अंतर्गत सेलमध्ये पाठवले जाईल. हा प्रक्रिया प्रोटीनवर कार्बोहायड्रेट आणि इतर अणू जोडण्याच्या समावेश करते. इतर विकल्पांमध्ये वेगवेगळ्या अर्गॅनेलच्या कार्याचे वर्णन आहे, उदाहरणार्थ, लिपिड संश्लेषण हे स्मूथ एंडोप्लाझ्मिक रेटिक्यूलममध्ये आणि एटीपी उत्पादन हे मायट्रोकॉन्ड्रियामध्ये होते.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the scientific terminology used in Marathi textbooks.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a feature of the centrioles?
choices: They are surrounded by a membrane
They are made of nine triplets of tubulin protein
They are found in all types of cells
They are involved in the synthesis of ribosomal RNA
questions.solution: Centrioles are made of nine triplets of tubulin protein arranged in a cartwheel-like structure. The other options are incorrect because centrioles are not surrounded by a membrane, they are not found in all types of cells, and ribosomal RNA synthesis occurs in the nucleolus, not the centrioles.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी केंट्रिओल की विशेषता है?
choices: वे एक झिल्ली से घिरे रहते हैं
वे ट्यूबूलिन प्रोटीन के नौ त्रिकों से बने होते हैं
वे सभी प्रकार की कोशिकाओं में पाए जाते हैं
वे राइबोसोमल आरएनए के संश्लेषण में भाग लेते हैं
hi.solution: केंट्रिओल ट्यूबूलिन प्रोटीन के नौ त्रिकों से बने होते हैं जो कार्टवील जैसी संरचना में व्यवस्थित होते हैं। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि केंट्रिओल एक झिल्ली से घिरे नहीं होते हैं, वे सभी प्रकार की कोशिकाओं में नहीं पाए जाते हैं और राइबोसोमल आरएनए का संश्लेषण न्यूक्लिओलस में होता है, न कि केंट्रिओल में।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard biological terminology in Hindi.

questions.stem: If a cell is actively involved in protein synthesis, which structure would be most abundant?
questions.solution: The rough endoplasmic reticulum (RER) is most abundant in cells actively involved in protein synthesis because it has ribosomes on its surface, which are directly involved in making proteins. The smooth endoplasmic reticulum is involved in lipid synthesis, not protein production. Lysosomes are responsible for breaking down materials, and mitochondria generate energy, not proteins.

hi.stem: यदि कोशिका प्रोटीन संश्लेषण में सक्रिय रूप से लगी हुई है, तो कौन सी संरचना सबसे अधिक पाई जाएगी?
hi.solution: कांटेदार एंडोप्लाज्मिक रेटिकुलम (RER) प्रोटीन संश्लेषण में सक्रिय रूप से लगी कोशिकाओं में सबसे अधिक पाया जाता है क्योंकि इसकी सतह पर राइबोसोम होते हैं, जो प्रोटीन बनाने में सीधे लगे रहते हैं। चिकना एंडोप्लाज्मिक रेटिकुलम लिपिड संश्लेषण में लगा रहता है, प्रोटीन उत्पादन में नहीं। लाइसोसोम सामग्री के विघटन के लिए जिम्मेदार होते हैं और माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया ऊर्जा उत्पन्न करते हैं, प्रोटीन नहीं।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard Hindi biological terminology.

mr.stem: जर कोशिका प्रोटीन संश्लेषणात सक्रिय असेल, तर कोशिकामध्ये कोणती संरचना सर्वात जास्त प्रमाणात असेल?
mr.solution: रॉफ एंडोप्लाझ्मिक रेटिक्युलम (RER) प्रोटीन संश्लेषणात सक्रिय असलेल्या कोशिकांमध्ये सर्वात जास्त प्रमाणात असते कारण त्याच्या पृष्ठभागावर राइबोसोम्स असतात, जे प्रोटीन तयार करण्यात सीधा सहभागी असतात. स्मूथ एंडोप्लाझ्मिक रेटिक्युलम लिपिड संश्लेषणात असते, प्रोटीन उत्पादनात नाही. लायसोसोम्स द्रव्यांचे विघटन करतात आणि माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया ऊर्जा उत्पादन करतात, प्रोटीन नाही.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard Marathi biological terminology.

questions.stem: What is the significance of the 9+2 array in cilia and flagella?
choices: It helps in the storage of genetic material
It enables the movement of the cell
It is responsible for protein synthesis
It regulates the flow of ions
questions.solution: The 9+2 array in cilia and flagella is significant because it enables the movement of the cell. This arrangement of microtubules allows the bending and movement of cilia and flagella. The other options are incorrect because the 9+2 array is not related to storing genetic material, protein synthesis, or ion regulation.

hi.stem: सीलिया और फ्लैजेला में 9+2 व्यवस्था का क्या महत्व है?
choices: यह आनुवंशिक सामग्री के भंडारण में सहायता करता है
यह कोशिका के गति की अनुमति देता है
यह प्रोटीन संश्लेषण के लिए उत्तरदायी है
यह आयनों के प्रवाह को नियंत्रित करता है

hi.critique: Translation is accurate, maintains original meaning, and uses standard biological terminology in Hindi.

mr.stem: किलिया आणि फ्लॅजेला मध्ये 9+2 अॅरेची महत्त्वाची काय आहे?

questions.stem: Why are prokaryotic ribosomes considered to be different from eukaryotic ribosomes in terms of function?
choices: Because prokaryotic ribosomes are not involved in protein synthesis
Because eukaryotic ribosomes are found in the cytoplasm
Because prokaryotic ribosomes can be targeted by certain antibiotics
questions.solution: Prokaryotic ribosomes are different from eukaryotic ones in that they can be targeted by certain antibiotics, which is a key distinction in their function and structure. The other options are incorrect because prokaryotic ribosomes are not larger, are involved in protein synthesis, and eukaryotic ribosomes are also found in the cytoplasm.

questions.stem: Which organelle is known as the 'powerhouse of the cell'?
questions.solution: Mitochondria are known as the 'powerhouse of the cell' because they generate most of the cell's supply of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) through the process of cellular respiration. The endoplasmic reticulum is involved in protein and lipid synthesis, the Golgi apparatus modifies and packages proteins, and lysosomes contain enzymes for breaking down waste materials. None of these organelles are primarily responsible for energy production.
